tools.name: list_content
tools.description: List published entries on this site, newest first, optionally filtered to one section (art, posts, recipes, melange, open-source) or one tag.

tools.name: open_entry
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a specific entry on this site by its path or slug, e.g. 'posts/1779066375000-farfield'.

tools.name: read_current_page
tools.description: Return the markdown source of the page currently open, with front matter and images resolved to public URLs. Cheaper and cleaner than parsing the rendered DOM.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search this site's writing, photography notes, and recipes by keyword. Returns titles, excerpts, and both HTML and markdown URLs.
